turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Thank you for seeing me. I've got a client call at 4:40, so tell me why my son found out about a zero on his phone in the middle of class.
Then tell me what you have, Hale. Start with who decided on the zero, and when.
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
Owen has never lied to me, and you have not shown me anything yet. Are you calling me a liar too? Name what you have, or I'm going to the principal's office when we're done here.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.
I'm not bullying you, Hale. I'm asking who decided on the zero, and whether anyone asked Owen before they did. Answer those two questions.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You're the one who asked me here. Who decided on the zero, Hale, and did anyone speak to Owen first?
